lines.speaker: 病人
lines.hanzi: 医生，我生病了，身体不好。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng, wǒ shēngbìng le, shēntǐ bù hǎo.
lines.english: Doctor, I'm sick, body not good.

lines.speaker: 病人
lines.pinyin: Chī le, dànshì háishi bù hǎo.
lines.english: Took it, but still not good.

lines.speaker: 医生
lines.hanzi: 多喝水，多休息，一星期会好。
lines.pinyin: Duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi, yī xīngqī huì hǎo.
lines.english: Drink more water, rest more, will be good in a week.
